prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In After Adoption Flow Reorder: Reorder the onboarding flow so sign-in takes place after pet adoption and photo upload, right before final waiting. (why: 77.0% sign-in conversion drops potential users before they have created emotional investment in their pet.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence and Multi-Device Hint: Display a explicit reassurance hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that signing in preserves pet state across app re-launches. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Story Scroll Quick Start Copy Callout: Update intro story screen text with action-oriented copy explaining fast setup paths. (why: Users take an average of 514s on path selection due to narrative ambiguity.)
3: [finish, incentive] Desktop Shortcut Cheat Sheet Incentive Banner: Add a visual hotkey card and completion badge on the home intro screen to encourage immediate interaction. (why: 3 support tickets noted post-onboarding confusion on pet commands and controls.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Pre-Made Pet Selection Carousel Redesign: Redesign pet pick view into a dynamic split visual stage showing pet traits and instant selection cards. (why: Adoption stage experiences a 71.9% completion rate; visual clarity speeds up pet selection.)

scores.note: Deferring auth after value creation significantly reduces upfront sign-in churn, but requires flow reordering.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in dropoff; low-cost copy hint to address account loss fear.
Addresses long 514s average duration on step 1 with simple copy quick-start callout.
Finish step has lowest conversion (64.8%); cheat sheet card targets post-onboarding confusion mentioned in tickets.
Adoption loses 28.1% of users; full stage redesign boosts clarity but requires new UI release.
